crossRefs.note: So he sent his brothers away, and they departed. He said to them, “See that you don’t quarrel on the way.”
Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.
Therefore watch carefully how you walk, not as unwise, but as wise,
Nevertheless each of you must also love his own wife even as himself; and let the wife see that she respects her…

So then, let’s follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.
Follow after love and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.

Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
Let him turn away from evil and do good. Let him seek peace and pursue it.

translations.web: See that no one returns evil for evil to anyone, but always follow after that which is good for one another and for all.
translations.bsb: Make sure that no one repays evil for evil. Always pursue what is good for one another and for all people.
translations.kjv: See that none render evil for evil unto any man; but ever follow that which is good, both among yourselves, and to all men.
translations.asv: See that none render unto any one evil for evil; but always follow after that which is good, one toward another, and toward all.
